set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Circular seating (mixed facing)
set.stimulus:
Ten persons, Asha, Divya, Geeta, Harish, Jatin, Mohan, Omkar, Pooja, Rohan and Vidya, sit around a circular table, not necessarily in the same order. Some of them face the centre while the others face outside (away from the centre). Left and right are taken from each person's own point of view.

1. Jatin sits to the immediate right of Pooja, who faces outside.
2. The immediate neighbours of Rohan face opposite directions.
3. Only one person sits between Rohan and Omkar when counted from the right of Rohan.
4. Omkar sits second to the right of the one who sits to the immediate left of Geeta.
5. Divya and Harish face opposite directions.
6. Jatin sits exactly opposite Omkar.
7. Only one person sits between Pooja and Vidya.
8. Harish sits third to the right of Asha, who faces the centre.
9. The one who sits second to the left of Omkar faces outside.
10. Asha sits third to the right of Mohan.
11. The one who sits second to the left of Divya faces the centre.
